title: Reversing Character Animation Process // Unholstering handgun and jumping forward
author: PDeperson
selftext:

Reversing Character Animation Process // Unholstering handgun and jumping forward

comments.author: fujibear
comments.body: The fluidity in this animation sequence looks really smooth. I've been experimenting with procedural animation blending myself and always struggle with making weapon transitions feel natural rather than robotic. The way you handled the momentum transfer from the unholster into the jump is particularly impressive. How did you approach the timing curves for this? I find that getting the overlap between the draw motion and the anticipation for the jump can make or break the whole sequence.

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body:
Thanks, I didn’t realize it would turn out this fluid, haha. This project started with a few of my athlete friends. we wanted to streamline the way 3D animation is created using low cost single camera AI motion capture to 3D animation tools.  
 If enough people are interested, I’d love to break down the entire process so everyone can learn it for free.  
Here’s the project landing page where you can get updates…
